newsitem.title: ITALY: BankItaly names Finocchiaro vice director general.
newsitem.headline: BankItaly names Finocchiaro vice director general.

text.p: Antonio Finocchiaro has been appointed as a Bank of Italy vice director general, replacing Tommaso Padoa Schioppa who was recently named as chairman of Italian stock market regulator Consob.
A central bank statement annnounced the appointment of Finocchiaro, 59, who joined the Bank of Italy in 1961 and has been secretary general since 1985.

Padoa Schioppa, who took up his new post on Thursday replacing Enzo Berlanda, who was on Friday elected chairman of the European regional committee of the International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO), Consob announced.
